full_page.content:
St. Bonaventure Monastery 1740 Mt. Elliott Ave. Detroit, Mich.
July 13, 1934
Adrian O Malley Herm. Kiefer Hosp'1
God bless you Adrian ..... But?
Come, shake off that worry ..... "Get on the job" again and come over till I pull your ears for .... St. Anthony, as Patron of Lost Things must do something to get you O.K. However, the dear Good God always knows best. . .
Praised be His Holy Name!
Fr. Solanus, O.M.Cap.
